content.text:
Implemented Linux-only swipe-to-seek feedback:

- **Removed the center seek HUD on Linux** (no center indicator while scrubbing).
- **During horizontal drag/seek**, the **bottom folder/crumb line** now shows:
  - `target position / duration`
  - plus `progress%`
- **After the gesture ends**, the temporary crumb preview clears automatically.

Screenshots (captured on Linux via the desktop automation harness):

- During gesture: `./.tmp/agent_shots/during_seek.png`  
  ![during](.tmp/agent_shots/during_seek.png)
- Post gesture: `./.tmp/agent_shots/post_seek.png`  
  ![post](.tmp/agent_shots/post_seek.png)

Files changed:
- `lib/widgets/hero_feedback_surface.dart`
- `lib/screens/void_screen.dart`

(`flutter analyze` passes.)
